activity_summary: You rehearsed Richard the Third from the rolls. The three cues from Friday, Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam, were left as they were. Burbage kept the wooing at half voice. You were in the play at two. The comedy was not in the room, and no part of it was copied. Edith's eight shillings and the Queen's twenty pound were named and not touched.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the three cues and refused to finish the comedy in the parlour.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Kept the wooing at half and would not have the last line in his ear.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Held the rehearsal to Richard and named the two sums without collecting them.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Confirmed the three cues and did not ask for the reason.
